text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh, rumble!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho! A golden opportunity! Is this a dream?! Am I dreaming?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer! This our chance to race Suzuka again before the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Fan Fest—a time when Tracen Academy welcomes fans onto campus with a variety of events.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The highlight is the sports competition, where the students participate in events they don't normally do, like ball games and martial arts.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: She's still got the edge on me in running, but maybe I can take her in a different event…

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Silence Suzuka claims a sweeping victory in racewalking too! She just marched on silent and steady!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I was completely focused on walking… Did I do well?

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka dominates the volleyball match with a superhuman—no, super-Umamusume jump!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All I did was run and jump. My teammate fed me the ball perfectly…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No way! She's even untouchable outside of racing! She's a natural athlete!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I've got it! I can take her in a three-legged race!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka dominates the three-legged race as well! Silence Suzuka and Special Week—a match made in heaven!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We did it, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?! Et tu, Spe?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter! Some way, somehow, I gotta beat Suzuka and get myself back on track!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I don't care what it takes, Trainer! I'll do anything!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this fair and square, Suzuka! In the ring! Let's wrestle!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whaaat? But that's your specialty, El!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is there even a wrestling event? I think there's sumo wrestling, but…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sumo is fine!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go, Suzuka! Let's get our sumo on!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, w-wait a minute…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa drags Silence Suzuka to the ring, and the sumo match begins.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hu—what?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It doesn't take long before El Condor Pasa is knocked out of the ring.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: W-wow… I was railroaded! She blasted forward like a runaway train with immense strength!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: This is Silence Suzuka! The OP train!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You're the only one who has a chance!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! This cheering… this hope! Can I really let their calls go unanswered?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No! Of course not! Suzuka, one more round! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zoom!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Aggghhh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But it's not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa stands back up heroically each time her fans cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And each time she stands up, her own spirits rise as well.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're still standing?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Everyone's cheerin' for me to win! This is the last—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zoom!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Aaaughhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, El Condor Pasa doesn't win even a single bout.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Now for our interview with this year's MVP, Silence Suzuka. Any comments?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm completely exhausted…

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Next up, this year's recipient of the Tenacity Prize, El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I-I… I'm so devastated!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Suzuka! Team El is gonna grind your army into dust one day! You hear me?! DUST!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Overwhelmed with frustration, El Condor Pasa ends up sounding like a heel wrestler.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your support, everyone! You won't regret it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Just you wait! One day, I will have… my reveeenge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Heartwarming applause and laughter breaks out in the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she lost, El Condor Pasa's incredible determination has won the hearts of fans.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Uhh… judges? Could you make El the MVP?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Personally, I think she's the biggest reason the Fan Fest was so exciting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Quite a generous comment, considering how much the Fan Fest served to reaffirm Silence Suzuka's fearsome strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My toe is… outside the ring…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Did I… do it?! I did it! I finally won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa wrings out every last drop of her strength to pull off a win, and the audience goes wild!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Now for our interview with this year's MVP, Silence Suzuka. Any comments?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not the real MVP.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You should be interviewing El. She's the one that got the crowd going.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Well then, El Condor Pasa. Any comments?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, thank you, everyone! Thank you so much! I'm so grateful!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's thanks to your support that I could beat Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa is enveloped in the wild cheering. Without a doubt, her fans will be watching her next race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: See you at the Takarazuka Kinen, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I've been looking forward to a rematch ever since the Mainichi Okan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You're the greatest obstacle before me on my journey to success—the dragon at the gates! But I'm stronger than ever, so get ready for a fight!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All right, but you won't win this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What has been won, and what has yet to be achieved. It seems El Condor Pasa has made her determination clear to Silence Suzuka.
